notes_for_editor: Record coordinates (54.04556, -108.43889) match the websiteservice list (54-02.7333 N, 108-26.3333 W); no correction. Record agency 'Saskatchewan Public Safety Agency (formerly Dept. of Natural Resources)' is not confirmed by any page read; the towermen list says the Department of Natural Resources is 'now called Saskatchewan Environment and Resource Management or SERM', so the agency line needs a human check. Two WebSearch calls and a firetower.org search returned no page on this tower. The name matches Kingsmere Lake and river in Prince Albert National Park (search snippet only, not read); no source ties these coordinates to the park. Not checked: Saskatchewan Archives reports. The towermen note on Richard Sevigny (all towers condemned after mid-August 2001, six to be rebuilt) names no towers and is not applied here.
